notes: SR78 Container Store Decor (containerstore.com). ACCESS: same route as the prior Home-Decor pass -- curl_cffi with Chrome-family impersonation (chrome131/chrome124/chrome120/chrome116), requests paced ~4-6s apart with profile rotated per request; every request in this session returned HTTP 200 (no PerimeterX block hit on any of the 17 URLs fetched for this batch). DISCOVERY: opened the full department mega-menu (embedded JSON nav tree in the /s/home-decor/1 page, all L1/L2Categories keys) plus the site's own 'Featured' top-nav department, which is a curated cross-catalogue merchandising hub distinct from ordinary Shop-by-Department nav (siblings: Trending: Fun Finds, Trending: Best-Sellers, Trending: New & Now, Trending: Organizer's Favorites, Lifestyle: Sustainable Living, etc.). Only one Best-Sellers-type node exists sitewide: 'Trending: Best-Sellers' (categoryId 91887, /s/featured/best-sellers/12). Checked whether 91887 has its own department-level children the way 'New & Now' (92800) and 'Clearance' (62895) do -- it does not; 91887 is a single flat listing with no subnav array in the nav's category map. Also checked Elfa's 'Solutions' subnav item (labelled 'best-selling-solutions' in its URL slug) -- that is Elfa's own component-bundle merchandising concept ('Solutions'), not a Bestsellers listing, and was excluded (URL slug wording only, not a genuine Bestsellers page -- confirmed by its own nav label 'Solutions' and breadcrumb, no best-seller framing on the page itself). No other 'Top Sellers'/'Popular'/'Trending'/'Customer Favorites' node maps to a Bestsellers concept anywhere in the full nav dump, footer, or on-page copy searched. Site search not used as primary discovery per brief (nav+embedded-JSON already exhaustive and authoritative here, page metadata explicitly labels the category tree). No local-language variants applicable (USA/English site).
